general.descriptionTextModule: View statistics about processed messages in the message queue system
general.totalMessagesHelp: Shows how many messages have been successfully processed within the configured time window
general.averageTimeHelp: The average time (in seconds) messages spend waiting in the queue before processing. Helps identify delays or bottlenecks
general.processingWindowHelp: Shows the time of the oldest message currently included in the statistics. The window duration is configured in system settings
general.messageTypesHelp: Breakdown of different message types processed, showing how many of each type were handled. Helps identify if certain message types are overwhelming the queue
general.emptyStateSubline: No message queue statistics have been collected yet.
